clauses.text: a sideways three-finger swipe on the touchpad moves Home to the next or previous group, and a vertical one does nothing

steps.do: On Home, swipe three fingers left across the trackpad, then three fingers right.
steps.expect: Home slides to the next group, then back to the previous one.

steps.do: Swipe three fingers up or down.
steps.expect: Nothing changes. The swipe does nothing while an app, a dialog or a text field has the focus.

clauses.text: on a touch screen, one finger from the group area moves Home to the next group

steps.do: On a touch screen, drag one finger sideways from the group area on Home.
steps.expect: Home moves to the next or previous group with a short slide, which is not shown when reduced motion is on.
